mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, conditions are clear at Verona City Hall under a waning crescent moon.

The Verona Plan Commission has a meeting scheduled for December 7th to discuss site plans for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park, while the Public Works department reminds residents to subscribe to their newsletter for updates on street maintenance and utility projects.
You can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market and live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.
On October 25th, local law enforcement responded to a report of a vehicle stationary for over 20 minutes, leading to the arrest of a 40-year-old man for O W I.
We are looking forward to a great treat today, and you can head over when the doors open today at 10:00 AM to enjoy the flavor of the day.
